searchText: Hi all. I'm working on some code in Zig (it wants to be a Portal client when it grows up 😉 ) but got stuck on signing ENRs. I'm using data from test vector from the spec and got verifying records to work. But when I try to sign a record with test vector private key, I get a different signature. I'd really appreciate help. The code is here: https://github.com/dszlachta/kaz/blob/feature/enr/lib/enr/record.zig#L219 (make test executes the tests) Do you have a test if you calculate the correct rlp or not? do you check the other impl https://github.com/gballet/zig-rlp I use the same `toRlp` function in `verify` and that works. I also have a general test if my encoder produces correct results: https://github.com/dszlachta/kaz/blob/feature/enr/lib/rlp/encode_test.zig -- do you think I should add another to strictly check record content (`[seq, k, v, ...]`) encoding? Thanks, I somehow missed this one. I was looking into Zabi, but it doesn't support lists
